semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Trelleborg Sealing Solutions provides specialized sealing solutions that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing and processing equipment.
summary: Trelleborg Sealing Solutions Ltd is a global supplier specializing in advanced polymer-based sealing solutions for the semiconductor industry. They offer a range of products including O-Rings, hydraulic seals, and mechanical face seals, tailored to meet the specific needs of semiconductor manufacturing and processing equipment.
capabilities: Custom sealing solutions for semiconductor equipment
